title: Romenagri in the browser
summary: Compile the vendored Romenagri to WebAssembly with a JavaScript wrapper, so the pages can call roman() and devanagari() themselves, with output byte-identical to the C build on every sutra.
how: Build the vendored C and lex with Emscripten; reproduce its own Makefile's pipeline, no rewrite.
Make the wrapper read lines on stdin under node with --roman, and export roman() for the page.
